note: QSL-2743. Row-contract vectors for FR-830 (selected model-union witness rows). They reuse the declarations of domain-package-acme-shapes.json (Shape Flag(Boolean)/Empty/Both(Pair); List Nil/Cons(Cell); Cell(Integer, List); Nest(Pair, Shape)) and the package fixtures/positive-model-tuple-union.json as read by model-tuple-union-vectors.json; they do not restate the declaration semantics (FR-322 'Tuple value types and payload-bearing variant types', FR-440, FR-441). Every opaque value (type_handle, settled_key, original_case, original_type) is an invented producer string, not derived from a name or a node. `model_unions` is the sidecar array of FR-830; a case's `scope` is `full` or `reached` with the `request` node; `budget` is the whole charge of the join (FR-830 'Work and storage'), in the units that section defines. Patches are RFC 6902 over a case's `model_unions`; `document_patch` is RFC 6902 over the `domain_package` of model-tuple-union-vectors.json. These vectors are published inputs and expected results only; no reader implements FR-830 yet and nothing here is qualified by running them.

positive.note: Authored order Flag, Empty, Both is carried canonically as Both, Empty, Flag with positions 2, 1, 0; rows sort List before Shape.
Shape reaches Boolean and Pair; Pair reaches Boolean and Integer; List is not reached.
The List row is wrong but is not in the reached closure, so it is neither inspected, charged nor retained; MUW-R-35 refuses the same rows under full scope.
List reaches Cell; Cell reaches Integer and List; the visited List is not expanded again.
Nest is a tuple and needs no row; its Shape position makes Shape reached.
model-tuple-union-vectors.json TK-08: Shape.Flag's payloadType is Clock. The row keeps the authored payload with no node and no original_type; Empty stays nullary.
List gains a nullary Empty beside Shape.Empty; the two cases are two members with member declarations k/8a10 and k/5d02.
Every join passes with producer values the reader cannot authenticate: the rows are admitted and their opaque values returned byte for byte. Admission is not a claim of provenance.
